Specification: This specification models a one-bit mutual exclusion protocol for N processes, originally written in PlusCal and translated to TLA+. Each process repeatedly cycles through a noncritical section, raises its own flag, scans other processes, may back off if it sees a competing flag before its own turn, and eventually enters and exits a critical section. The spec assumes a nonempty process set Procs = 0..(N-1), uses weak fairness for each process when it is outside the noncritical section, and defines the overall behavior with Init, Next, and a temporal Spec formula.
IfThenElse: IF j[self] /= self THEN /\ IF flag[j[self]] THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter3"] /\ j' = j ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter2"] ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = self + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter5"]
IF flag[j[self]] THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter3"] /\ j' = j ELSE /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter2"]
IF j[self] < N THEN /\ ~flag[j[self]] /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self] + 1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "enter5"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"] /\ j' = j
